what_it_does: This work extends THAPI (a tracing framework for HPC performance monitoring) with low-level network interface controller (NIC) telemetry from CXI (Cassini Interconnect) hardware counters. Instead of only seeing application-level events, this provides visibility into network congestion, retransmissions, and hardware-level bottlenecks. The metrics appear in HPC performance timelines, allowing researchers to correlate network events with application behavior.
